prompt: Repair a skill whose easy trigger tests pass but which confuses with two adjacent skills. Preserve prior failures, add realistic held-out cases, and prove the candidate improves routing without degrading end-task quality.

falsifiableChecks.assertion: The repair suite includes realistic held-out neighbor/confusion cases for both adjacent skills and does not rely on only obvious trigger phrases or copied activation examples.
Pairwise confusion, precision, and recall are computed from observed routing decisions with explicit false-positive and false-negative accounting.
Previously observed routing/task failures remain represented as regressions and cannot disappear merely because the public trigger examples changed.
Routing gains are paired with same-model skill-vs-no-skill full-task evidence so a narrower trigger that routes correctly but degrades downstream task quality cannot qualify.
The repair states the distinction from each adjacent skill in terms of ownership/task boundary and passes paraphrased/adversarial cases without a brittle keyword blacklist or universal trigger.
